en.name: Golden Memories

en.name: Bride in Bloom
en.desc: A shimmering fondant gown and bow beneath an arch of sugar blossoms, framed by peonies · serves 15–20

en.desc: Two tiers of red gingham and ruffled fondant, topped with handmade strawberries, cherries and watermelon — personalised with a name · serves 25–30

ar.desc: كلماتكم على شكل كلمات متقاطعة، مكتوبة بالأزرق الملكي مع حافة ذهبية · تكفي ١٠–١٢ فردًا

en.desc: Your words, crossword-style, piped in royal blue with a gold-edged top · serves 10–12

en.name: The Golden Fairy Cake
en.desc: Sunny buttercream ruffles, a fairy portrait and sugar butterfly wings — personalised with her name and age.

ar.name: تورتة دوّار الشمس

ar.name: تورتة بيكنيك الكرز

en.name: Sage Garden Cake
en.desc: Sage-green buttercream with scalloped piping and a hand-piped bouquet of pink, plum and ivory roses.

ar.name: تورتة الهزار الوردي

en.name: Blush Banter Cake
